title: 2016 HMMT February Guts Problem 5
statement: Patrick and Anderson are having a snowball fight. Patrick throws a snowball at Anderson which is shaped like a sphere with a radius of 10 centimeters. Anderson catches the snowball and uses the snow from the snowball to construct snowballs with radii of 4 centimeters. Given that the total volume of the snowballs that Anderson constructs cannot exceed the volume of the snowball that Patrick threw, how many snowballs can Anderson construct?
